_comment: CURATED catalog of capabilities. Sibling of connections/catalog.json and
closed for the same reason: the agent PICKS an id from here, it never
drafts a free-form request or names a URL. What cuts off social
engineering isn't that the agent behaves well, it's that it has nowhere
to write.
ONE ENTRY = ONE JOB THE CLIENT UNDERSTANDS, not a skill. 'Being able to
make images' is, under the hood, three things (a config key, an
engine-skill exception and a skill of ours); the client sees one row.
The catalog is CLOSED to what already ships in the engine image (the 66
disabled skills + the 111 optional-skills) and to what we write
ourselves. No hub, no third-party repos: there's no skill_search, and
EVERYTHING installed and visible enters the system prompt on EVERY
request — the cost is linear.
purpose  -> what changes in the client's work, in their own words
how      -> who does it and how long it takes, in their own words
detects  -> how to tell whether the capability is ALREADY on this agent
installs -> what WE do when the client says yes
verifies -> what agent-check verifies against the engine image
effort: minutes | hours | days   (how long setup takes, not the work itself)
who: client_only | assisted | us
LEVEL (2026-08-19). Each entry says which side of the counter it's on:
level: base  -> ships on ALL agents. It isn't chosen or
billed separately: on the role's card it shows as
'included' and has no button. There are four, and they
aren't installed: they're PROTECTED from being turned
off (a misconfigured knob breaks them, which is why
agent-check compares the allowlist).
level: menu  -> chosen per role, generates a request, we install it.
STATUS (only while building; never shown to the client):
existing      -> already runs on today's agents
new-engine    -> is just an engine knob or a config key
new-kit       -> the skill has to be WRITTEN; until then the
internal_note says so and `how` promises the next
update
under-evaluation -> something still needs verifying (a library in the
image, a format, a legal review) before it can be sold
THE SOCIAL PACKAGE IS NO LONGER A BRAND, IT'S A ROW (2026-08-19). There
used to be five entries —brand-kit, social-content, post-image, images
and social-formats— with a `paquete: social` field so the portal would
draw them together. They collapsed into `social-package`, 'Your social
media with your identity', and the `paquete` field disappeared: a field
the portal could ignore wasn't enough, because as long as the 'images'
row existed it could be requested on its own. A single-verb capability
churns (Midjourney −46% in 90 days) and an image with no brand kit
produces the 'AI slop' that burns brands: now there's no id that names
the image alone. The components install TOGETHER, with brand-kit first,
and what we knew about each one lives in the internal_note of the row,
by subsection.
THE NAMES `verifies` AND `installs` ARE NOT THE SAME. They read
differently on purpose —one describes a state, the other an action— and
confusing them means writing a key nobody reads:
verifies -> toolset (ONE, string: the one that has to be on)
kit_skill (ONE) or kit_skills (SEVERAL, list)
engine_skills (list) · image (bool: ships in the image)
installs -> toolsets (LIST: go into platform_toolsets)
plugins (list) · kit_skills (list) · engine_skills (list)
config (config.yaml keys) · env (variables)
engine_skills are the ones that ship with the image and stay in the
allowlist (the four for reading documents: xlsx, docx, pdf,
ocr-and-documents)
PLUGINS VS KIT_SKILLS, AND THE LINE BETWEEN THEM IS CHECKED. What we write
lives in one of two places, and `installs` names the one it is really in:
the PLUGIN id when it lives in hermes-kit/plugins/, the bare skill name
while it still lives in hermes-kit/skills/. tools/check-plugins.py refuses a
`kit_skills` entry that names a plugin-owned skill and a `plugins` entry
that names a plugin nobody wrote, and roles/skills_split.py runs the same
check on every install. It is not bookkeeping: tools/plugin_set.py reads
`installs.plugins` off the `level: base` rows to decide what ships on EVERY
agent, so a base row pointing at the wrong home is a plugin the catalog
promises as already installed and the installer never copies.
`verifies` DID NOT MOVE, ON PURPOSE. It describes the agent's DELIVERED
layout, where a plugin's skill is flattened into kit-skills/ exactly as it
always was, so `verifies.kit_skills` naming brand-kit is still the truth
about a running agent. installs says where the SOURCE is; verifies says
what to look for on the disk.
The list comes from `notes/capabilities-50-verdict.md`: 50 candidates
weighed against three pieces of research (Uruguayan SMBs, global/LATAM
demand, maturity and cost) and a devil's-advocate pass. What was left OUT
is in there with the reason why, so it doesn't get reopened without new
data.

capabilities.label: Cálculos, planillas y documentos
capabilities.purpose: Que haga las cuentas y te arme la planilla, el Word o el PDF con tus datos, en vez de pasarte los números por mensaje para que los copies a mano.
capabilities.how: Ya viene puesta en todos los agentes: no hay que pedirla.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte: entra en tu cuota de modelos.
capabilities.internal_note: BASE: not installed, just protected from being turned off. `code_execution` is already in platform_toolsets on all three platforms (compose/config.base.yaml) and `xlsx`, `docx` and `pdf` are three of the four engine skills we leave on (the default-allowed list in tools/skills-knob.py and in agent-check). This is the one that unlocks the back office, which is where the money is: 65% of the consulting a Uruguayan SMB pays for is administration/accounting/finance (ANDE/INE 2024) and only half of micro-businesses track income and expenses. Nothing to write; the only thing that can break it is a misconfigured knob.

capabilities.label: Ver lo que le mandás
capabilities.purpose: Que le mandes la foto de una factura, una captura de pantalla o un PDF escaneado y lo lea, en vez de tener que escribirle vos lo que dice.
capabilities.how: Ya viene puesta en todos los agentes: no hay que pedirla.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte: entra en tu cuota de modelos.
capabilities.internal_note: BASE: the `vision` toolset is already in platform_toolsets and `ocr-and-documents` is the fourth engine skill in the allowlist. 'Just send the photo' is THE LATAM interaction (Pix-by-photo validated it) and OCR hits 94-98% on clean documents. WARNING THAT TRAVELS TO ANYTHING BUILT ON TOP OF THIS: it hallucinates plausible amounts in 1-3% of cases, so anything that goes to accounting passes through human approval — that's the reason for the human in the loop in invoices-to-data. `detects` goes by `toolset` and not `tool` on purpose: the vision tool's name is NOT verified against the engine image, and making one up would make the card offer something the agent already has. As of 2026-08-19 that NO LONGER falls into 'unknown': the adapter resolves the `toolset` branch against /v1/toolsets, and `vision` is in platform_toolsets on all three platforms (compose/config.base.yaml, lines 105, 118 and 131), so the row correctly answers active=True. The known limit of that endpoint still stands —it says the TOOLSET is on, not that its tools pass check_fn, which is what happens with image_gen— but vision has no external provider to fail, so this is enough here. The day the tool's name gets verified, it moves to {tool: ...} and the count becomes exact.

capabilities.label: Buscar en internet
capabilities.purpose: Que el agente busque y lea páginas para responderte con datos de hoy, en vez de trabajar solo con lo que le contaste.
capabilities.how: Ya viene puesta en todos los agentes: no hay que pedirla.
capabilities.internal_note: Today check_web_api_key returns False on every startup and the agent works around it with curl from the terminal. Possible backends: EXA_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY, PARALLEL_API_KEY, BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY, Firecrawl or a SEARXNG_URL of our own. ddgs doesn't work: the package isn't in the image. MOVED TO BASE on 2026-08-19: searching is the #1 declared use of AI at work in Uruguay (UTDT 2025) and web-monitoring, uy-tenders and company-research all hang off this one. WATCH THE COST: being base means the search key enters the FIXED cost of every agent (Tavily ~US$8/1k searches), so it ships with a usage cap. THE ROLLOUT REALITY, and it has to be said: TODAY check_web_api_key still returns False on deployed agents because we haven't put the Tavily key on them yet. The copy already says 'already installed' on purpose — base is the PRODUCT PROMISE and operations has to catch up to it, not the other way around; the catalog doesn't get watered down to paper over a pending rollout. As long as an agent is missing it, the `no-web-search` skill still holds and is the honest card: the agent says it can't search instead of making up the source. Its behavior does NOT change until the key is on every agent.

capabilities.label: Audios a texto
capabilities.purpose: Que le mandes un audio de WhatsApp o la grabación de una reunión y te la devuelva escrita, sin tener que escucharla de nuevo.
capabilities.how: Ya viene puesta en todos los agentes: no hay que pedirla.
capabilities.cost: Centavos por hora de audio, dentro de tu cuota de modelos.
capabilities.internal_note: PROMOTED from menu to base on 2026-08-19: charging for it separately means selling what others already give away — Meta made it native on WhatsApp (June 2026) and it's Zapia's #1 use case (1M users in LATAM). It's a hook, not a product. The `transcribe` skill is ALREADY written and install.sh ships it to everyone: the script decides provider, model and language (whisper-large-v3-turbo via OpenRouter, US$0.04/hour, verified 2026-08-06 — see notes/auxiliary-models.md) precisely so the cost doesn't depend on what the agent picks. It hangs off the auxiliary-models connection (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), which ships with the agent. WARNING for anything built on top: Whisper makes up phrases in ~1% of silences, so it isn't sold as literal transcription for legal use.

capabilities.label: Presupuestos y cotizaciones al toque
capabilities.purpose: Que armes el presupuesto en minutos y con tu formato: le decís qué te pidieron y te lo deja listo para mandar, con tus precios y tus condiciones.
capabilities.how: Viene con el rol de ventas; si ya lo tenés contratado, te la prendemos nosotros con una actualización. Antes te pedimos un presupuesto tuyo, para que los que arme salgan iguales a los que ya mandás.
capabilities.internal_note: WRITTEN on 2026-08-19: skills/quotes/ (SKILL.md, references/ejemplo.md and two scripts), declared by the sales role (role.json 0.2.0), so it travels inside the role's profile and not in kit-skills/. It's the strongest piece of evidence from the research: quoting by hand takes 2-4 hours, the client expects a reply in under 24, and speed is what closes the sale; there are standalone products at US$30-40/month and ROMA AI (UY) already automates this for 24 SMBs. NON-NEGOTIABLE GUARDRAIL: the client's own template first and the client's own numbers ALWAYS — a quote with a made-up price is worse than not having the capability, because it doesn't just get delayed: it gets charged. That's why the split is the usual one, and here it's real money: the model writes the words and `new_quote.py` resolves each line against `lista-precios.csv`; whatever it can't find comes back under `faltantes` and has no price. Three more things the script refuses to make up: the exchange rate (two currencies = two totals, UYU and USD coexist in Uruguay), the VAT rule (`mas_iva` vs `incluido` is asked ONCE and stored in formato.json) and the sequential number, which is only spent with --numerar and only if nothing is missing. The bootstrap is the same as brand-kit's: with no template or price list there's no quoting — both are requested together, an old quote of the client's and their list however they have it — and they're saved under workspace/presupuestos/ with save_setup.py, which also normalizes the two traps of transcribing Uruguayan prices ($ vs U$S, and 1.250,50). Combines with `vision`: a quote from a photo of what needs pricing. PENDING, same as invoices-to-data: `how` still says 'ships with your agent's next update', true for an agent already installed; the day the fleet gets updated it changes to 'We turn it on for you' and the markdown has to be regenerated with tools/capability-catalog.py --apply, because `how` DOES get rendered (`status` doesn't).

capabilities.label: Cargar facturas
capabilities.purpose: Que la foto o el PDF de la factura entre solo a tu planilla —fecha, proveedor, número y monto— sin que tengas que tipear nada.
capabilities.how: Viene con el rol de contabilidad; si ya lo tenés contratado, te la prendemos nosotros con una actualización. Cada carga te la muestra para que la confirmes antes de que quede escrita.
capabilities.internal_note: WRITTEN on 2026-08-19: plugins/invoices-to-data/skills/invoices-to-data/ (SKILL.md, references/cfe.md and scripts/verify_rows.py), declared by the accounting role (role.json 0.2.0), so it travels inside the role's profile and not in kit-skills/. Data entry is 43% of what gets automated in accounting (Intuit) and mandatory e-invoicing in Uruguay since 2026-01-01 is pushing SMBs to digitize. NON-NEGOTIABLE GUARDRAIL: human in the loop ALWAYS — OCR hallucinates plausible amounts in 1-3% of cases and a wrongly-entered amount doesn't get noticed until closing; confirmation is part of the flow, not an option. That got written down for the model as the SKILL.md's honesty contract: whatever couldn't be read comes back EMPTY and flagged, talking about confidence is forbidden, and nothing gets filled in from context or squared against the subtraction. The script checks the only thing arithmetic can verify —the RUT check digit, subtotal + VAT against the total, the rate against 22% and 10%— and does NOT propose corrected values, on purpose. And DGI/electronic invoicing is READ-ONLY, decided and not up for revisiting. PENDING: `how` still says 'ships with your agent's next update', which is true for an agent already installed; the day the fleet gets updated it changes to 'We turn it on for you' and the markdown has to be regenerated with tools/capability-catalog.py --apply, because `how` DOES get rendered (`status` doesn't).

capabilities.label: Cobranzas al día
capabilities.purpose: Que sepas quién te debe, desde cuándo y por cuánto, y que te deje escrito el mensaje para cobrarle.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. El mensaje lo redacta él; mandarlo lo decidís vos.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. Accounts receivable and payable are 46% of what gets automated in accounting (Intuit) and ROMA (UY) lists it among its use cases. In Uruguay bank transfer dominates (72-84% of payments), so matching against the statement matters as much as the reminder — that's where it hooks into bank-reconciliation. GUARDRAIL: the capability TRACKS and DRAFTS; sending goes through channels and approval. An agent that sends demand notices on its own is a problem with the client's own customer. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Tus redes con tu identidad
capabilities.purpose: Que tus redes salgan como tu empresa y no como cualquiera: los posteos escritos con tu voz, las imágenes con tus colores, tu tipografía y tu logo, y cada pieza con la medida que pide cada red, sin que tengas que recortar ni retocar nada.
capabilities.how: La prendemos nosotros. Lo primero que hace el agente es leer tu sitio y armarte el kit de marca —colores, tipografías y logo—; después te pregunta lo que no se puede deducir: cuál es el logo oficial y cómo le hablás a tu cliente. Con eso ya escribe y arma el resto; antes de darla por buena hacemos una prueba de imagen con vos.
capabilities.cost: Por imagen generada, dentro de tu cuota de modelos; el resto sin costo.
capabilities.internal_note:
SOLD AS A PACKAGE AND NOTHING ELSE (verdict from 2026-08-19): the five rows that used to exist —brand-kit, social-content, post-image, images and social-formats— collapsed into this one. It isn't portal cosmetics: there's no row to request 'images' on its own, because a single-verb capability churns (Midjourney -46% in 90 days) and an image with no brand kit is the 'AI slop' that burns the client's brand. The components install TOGETHER and brand-kit goes FIRST: it's the anti-slop moat, the only thing that separates 'your social media with your identity' from the generic template. Below, each component's internal_note AS IT WAS — each one cost real work and none of them gets summarized.

=== brand-kit ===
Doesn't need the web-search capability: the script downloads the site with urllib from the terminal, not through the web toolset, so it works the same on an agent with search turned off. It does need outbound internet access from the container. It's the raw material for social-content: without brand.json every piece comes out with a different criterion. SOCIAL PACKAGE: goes FIRST in install order — it's the anti-slop moat, the only thing that separates 'your social media with your identity' from the generic image that burns the brand.

=== social-content ===
Depends on brand-kit and the script checks it itself: without brand/brand.json it stops with missing_kit and the question already written out, instead of writing with a made-up tone. The limits live in scripts/new_post.py and references/formatos.md, verified 2026-08-13 — WATCH OUT, Instagram dropped hashtags from 30 to 5 in December 2025 and the carousel is 20 in the app but 10 via API. Recheck those numbers now and then. SOCIAL PACKAGE: sold inside 'Your social media with your identity', never as 'writing posts' on its own.

=== post-image ===
Generative since 2026-08-14, via the engine's image_generate tool. TWO THINGS THAT COST HALF A DAY: (1) aspect_ratio goes as a semantic name (portrait/landscape/square), not as "9:16" — with the raw ratio it does NOT fail, it falls back to the default and returns a horizontal image; measured: 9:16 gave 1280x720 and portrait gave 720x1280. (2) the API CANNOT be called from the terminal: the engine strips the environment's keys (hermes_cli/config.py:3982,4026,4084) so the agent's shell doesn't inherit them, so a script of our own dies with "missing OPENROUTER_API_KEY". That's correct: that key pays for all the inference. SEEDREAM IS LEFT OUT: $0.045 vs $0.2266 for gpt-5.4-image-2 (measured, 5x cheaper) and it respects the aspect ratio, but the plugin sends modalities image+text over /chat/completions and Seedream only returns image (404). It would qualify if the engine supported POST /api/v1/images. Needs vision for the verification step. SOCIAL PACKAGE.

=== images ===
VERIFIED on 2026-08-12 on an agent created from scratch: with `image_gen: {provider: openrouter}` in config.yaml, image_generate APPEARS in the tools (check_image_generation_requirements turns True because the plugins/image_gen/openrouter plugin exists in the image and its is_available() only requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY, which every one of our agents has). WHAT STILL ISN'T VERIFIED is the first real render: it wasn't tested with a real key, and the plugin itself warns that openai/* models on OpenRouter may require account activation or BYOK (_FALLBACK_MODEL google/gemini-3-pro-image). That's why `how` promises a test with the client, not that it ships working. Do NOT use bfl: it's video and requires a paid Nous account. On enabling, MANDATORY HARVEST from data/skills/*/social-content-workflows, which hand-canonizes the SVG. SOCIAL PACKAGE, and this is the entry that does NOT get sold on its own under any circumstances: a single-verb capability churns (Midjourney −46% in 90 days) and an image with no brand kit is exactly the 'AI slop' that burns the client's brand.

=== social-formats ===
Not written yet: it's the entry that proves the catalog also covers capabilities the engine has no concept of. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh. SOCIAL PACKAGE: it's the missing piece to close it out — the rest of the package already exists.

capabilities.label: Minutas de reuniones
capabilities.purpose: Que de la grabación salga la minuta: qué se acordó, qué quedó pendiente y de quién.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte del audio, que entra en tu cuota de modelos.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. It's THE proven combo of the moment (Fireflies, Fathom, Otter: a mature market) and the natural upsell on transcription, which is already base — the audio isn't billed, the summary is. GUARDRAIL: Whisper makes up phrases in ~1% of silences, so it's delivered as a summary of what was said and NOT as a literal record; nothing legal. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Respuestas de tu negocio
capabilities.purpose: Que las preguntas de siempre —precios, horarios, envíos, garantía— se contesten igual siempre, con lo que vos decís y no con lo que el agente supone.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Arranca con lo que ya venís contestando y te pregunta lo que falte.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. FAQs are the #1 agent use case per Salesforce and it's what makes the support role sellable. TWO GUARDRAILS: (1) a quality gate and an honest 'I don't know' — a bot that answers badly raises the end customer's churn 67%, so with no answer in the base it says it doesn't know and hands off to a person, never improvises; (2) the typical failure isn't day one but month six, with the base gone stale: KEEPING IT UP TO DATE IS PART OF THE CAPABILITY, not an extra — the skill has to flag when an answer has gone stale. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Vigilar páginas
capabilities.purpose: Que mire todos los días las páginas que te importan —una licitación nueva, una lista de precios publicada, una mención de tu negocio en una noticia— y te avise cuando algo cambia.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Vos le decís qué mirar; el chequeo es una vez por día.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte de la búsqueda, que ya viene con tu agente.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. Price-watching is a real market (US$1.2B) and n8n templates for this are among the most used. TWO HARD LIMITS, not preferences: (1) DAILY CADENCE AND NOTHING ELSE — hourly checking costs US$36-58/month per client and eats the entire role's price; daily costs US$1-2. (2) Via search API (the same backend as web-search), NEVER a browser: Cloudflare blocks agents by default since 2025 and a browser succeeds ~60% of the time against 78% for a person. If the client asks for 'go into the site and do the paperwork', the answer is no. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Licitaciones y compras estatales
capabilities.purpose: Que te avise cuando sale un llamado del Estado que te sirve, con qué piden y cuándo cierra, en vez de enterarte cuando ya cerró.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Le decís de qué rubros querés enterarte.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte de la búsqueda, que ya viene con tu agente.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. A pain point validated by the market: FOUR local tools exist that do only this (Tenderis, Gubly, ialicitaciones, ProveedorUY), and the 8-business-day windows force frequent monitoring. Via ARCE's open data, which is the stable path; the browser stays as an internal enabler for a narrow flow, never as a promise to the client. For us it's a capability OF A ROLE, not a standalone product: head-on against the four local players we don't compete. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Tu catálogo en tus canales
capabilities.purpose: Que tengas el catálogo armado y al día donde vendés —WhatsApp, Instagram y tus otros canales—: fotos, precios y descripciones que no se contradicen entre un canal y otro.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Armarlo y mantenerlo lo hace él; publicar en cada canal necesita que ese canal esté conectado.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. REPOSITIONED on 2026-08-19: it's NOT a catalog in a PDF or on a website of your own — it's a catalog FOR WhatsApp/IG/MELI, which is where the Uruguayan SMB sells (messaging is the #1 online sales channel at 39-43% and MELI is the reference for 72%). A website of your own was killed by the data: 54.6% answer 'I don't need one'. BOUNDARY GUARDRAIL: the capability BUILDS AND MAINTAINS; onboarding the channel is a CONNECTION (whatsapp, instagram) and goes through there. MELI IS NOT NAMED IN THE COPY (2026-08-19): the mercado-libre connection does NOT exist in connections/catalog.json, and naming a channel that can't be connected is promising the onboarding. To sell it by name, the connection has to enter the connections catalog first; only then does it come back into `purpose`. Gorillaz case: orders get validated against inventory, which is where it hooks into stock-control. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.purpose: Que se acuerde de cada cliente: qué compró, qué le prometiste y de qué hablaron la última vez, sin que se lo tengas que recordar vos.

capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. WhatsApp chatbots in LATAM sell WITH a basic CRM built in (US$59-199/month) and 'personalized recommendations' rank high on Salesforce's list: without customer memory, the agent looks new in every conversation. SCOPE GUARDRAIL: it's CRM-lite in workspace files, NOT a CRM — no pipeline, no stages, no funnel reports promised. The day a client needs that, it's a connection to their CRM, not this capability. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Fotos de producto listas
capabilities.purpose: Que tus fotos de producto queden listas para publicar: recorte parejo y la medida que pide cada canal. Son tus fotos, no imágenes inventadas.
capabilities.how: La prendemos nosotros, pero antes probamos en tu agente que las fotos salgan bien.
capabilities.internal_note: UNDER EVALUATION: still needs verifying which image libraries the engine image ships (Pillow is there, rembg and background removal are NOT verified) before promising a transparent background; `purpose` no longer promises it (removed 2026-08-19) and comes back once rembg is verified. REFOCUSED on product photos on 2026-08-19: it's exactly what Tiendanube and MELI validate with their own AI. Not to be confused with `images`, which generates: here what the client sends gets retouched, and that's why it doesn't carry the 'AI slop' guardrail. Once the library is verified, the skill gets written and ships with install.sh.

capabilities.label: Dossier de una empresa
capabilities.purpose: Que antes de la reunión te arme la ficha de la empresa con la que vas a hablar: a qué se dedica, quién la maneja y qué se dijo de ella últimamente.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente.
capabilities.cost: Sin costo aparte de la búsqueda, que ya viene con tu agente.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. Deep research is mature (93.9% on SimpleQA) and we tested it in-house: 43 dossiers of our own. Narrow audience: B2B and professional services — nobody asks for it at a storefront SMB, which is why it stays in the extended menu. Watch the cost: research is an agentic loop and an uncapped loop is the #1 pricing risk, not the search itself. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Contenido para LinkedIn
capabilities.purpose: Que escriba para LinkedIn con la forma de LinkedIn: más texto, otro tono y sin los hashtags de Instagram.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Necesita tu kit de marca; si no lo tenés, el agente te ofrece armarlo.
capabilities.internal_note: Not written yet. Sister of social-content: same structure, different limits, and reuses brand-kit. Niche but real — two thirds of Uruguayan micro-businesses are self-employment and the independent professional lives there. It does NOT enter the social package —it sells on its own, to a different audience— but it DEPENDS on it: the brand kit is no longer its own row, so `needs` points at social-package. Once it exists, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Extracto contra planilla
capabilities.purpose: Que cruce el extracto del banco con tu planilla y te marque lo que no coincide, en vez de revisar línea por línea.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Lo que no cierra te lo muestra: confirmás vos.
capabilities.internal_note: UNDER EVALUATION. Demand is real (assisted bookkeeping sells for US$69-199/month) and structured matching is mature, but it still needs checking what format each Uruguayan bank's statement comes in — if reading a scanned PDF is the only path, that's where the error creeps in. In Uruguay bank transfer dominates (72-84% of payments), so this and collections-followup are the same conversation. The human ALWAYS CONFIRMS: a badly closed reconciliation gets discovered months later. Once the format is verified, the skill gets written and ships with install.sh.

capabilities.label: Aguinaldo, licencia y aportes
capabilities.purpose: Que te calcule el aguinaldo, la licencia, el salario vacacional o los aportes con los números que rigen hoy, y te muestre de dónde salió cada cifra.
capabilities.how: La escribimos nosotros y llega con la próxima actualización de tu agente. Cada cálculo viene con la fuente oficial al lado, para que tu contador lo confirme.
capabilities.internal_note: NOT SOLD UNTIL SOMEONE WHO KNOWS REVIEWS IT: this entry's guardrail is legal, not technical. Recurrence is proven (the press re-explains it every semester; the Clean-In case went from 15 payroll runs to 1), but what we deliver is A CALCULATOR THAT CITES THE OFFICIAL SOURCE (BPS/MTSS, regulation and date) — NEVER labor-law advice. 'Your accountant confirms it' is part of the delivery, not a disclaimer at the bottom. Stays under-evaluation until the legal review; a client's request still counts as a demand signal for us. After that, it goes into the kit and reaches everyone via install.sh.

capabilities.label: Agenda de turnos
capabilities.purpose: Que tome los turnos, los ponga en tu agenda y le recuerde a cada uno el día antes.
capabilities.how: Todavía no la damos: necesita que tu agenda esté conectada. Cuando eso esté, la prendemos nosotros.
capabilities.internal_note: DO NOT SELL YET: WAITING ON THE google-workspace CONNECTION. Demand is among the strongest in the research (scheduling is in the top 3 of what an SMB buys) and that's exactly why the temptation is to ship the crippled version — the agent writes the appointment into a spreadsheet nobody checks from their phone, the end customer shows up and there's no appointment. That version generates the complaint, not the sale. With the calendar connected and the reminder going out over the client's channel, it sells itself. Until then it stays under-evaluation and a request serves as a demand signal.
